items.headline: $AQUA Dominates 97% of Stellar DEX Volume
items.summary: DefiLlama data shows $AQUA's Aquarius protocol now drives 97% of all DEX trading on Stellar, cementing its grip on the ecosystem.

items.headline: $ZRO Taps Samsung Card, Kakao Pay as Validators
items.summary: LayerZero added Samsung Card, Kakao Pay and ZAN as validators for its upcoming Zero blockchain, which uses ZK proofs to split execution from verification.

items.headline: $CRV Fees Jump 61% as YieldBasis LP Fees Double
items.summary: Curve's fee revenue surged 61% while YieldBasis liquidity provider fees more than doubled, signaling renewed DeFi yield activity.

items.headline: $ZEC Urged to Cut Off Legacy Sapling Pool Sooner
items.summary: Zakura is pushing Zcash to end Sapling deposits earlier, with about 376,530 $ZEC still sitting in the legacy privacy pool. Withdrawals would stay open.

items.headline: $MORPHO Fees Up 66% as Base Activity Booms
items.summary: Activity on Coinbase's Base chain pushed Morpho Blue's monthly fees up 66%, highlighting growing lending demand on the L2.
